build.flagSemantics: Read from the live snapshot gdn_linear_attn.py forward (the in_proj_ba block at lines 553-601 and the mirror out_proj block at 674-723). The RUNTIME gate is `os.environ.get("LUMO_FB_KERNEL_ROWS") == "1"` (NOT a var literally named LUMO_FB_BATCH_INVARIANT_BA_PROJ — that string is only the comment label at line 553). When the gate is True AND attn_metadata.num_spec_decodes>1 AND num_prefills==0 AND num_decodes==0 AND spec_query_start_loc is present, the code: (1) reads per-spec spans from spec_query_start_loc, (2) computes row_len = max span length, (3) pad_rows = max(num_spec_decodes, int(LUMO_FB_PROJ_PAD_ROWS, default "4")), (4) if pad_rows>num_spec_decodes builds a zero-padded (pad_rows*row_len, hidden) buffer, copies the real rows in, issues ONE batched self.in_proj_ba(padded) GEMM, then scatters/cats the real-row slices back (pads discarded); else it reshapes to nspec*row_len. Net effect: the bf16 in_proj_ba (and at 674-723 the out_proj) GEMM is always issued at a FIXED, tree_n-independent M, so cuBLASLt picks ONE kernel/Split-K => a/b are M-invariant on the spine row. Lossless-by-construction: a GEMM row = W @ hidden[row], independent per row; zero pad-rows contribute nothing. All wrapped in try/except: pass (silent stock fallback on any error). The whole block is gated solely by LUMO_FB_KERNEL_ROWS=1; LUMO_FB_PROJ_PAD_ROWS only sizes the pad.

build.padValue: LUMO_FB_PROJ_PAD_ROWS default = 16. Chosen >= the cat9 max tree_n=10 so pad_rows>num_spec_decodes is satisfied (the code requires pad_rows>nspec to take the padded branch; at nspec=10 a default of 4 would FALL THROUGH to the elif reshape and NOT pin a fixed shape). 16 is the next power-of-2 above 10, comfortably tree_n-independent for the [6,6,4,6]/cat9 trees, and gives cuBLASLt one constant M=16*row_len shape. The in-code default is still "4" (legacy); the launcher overrides to 16 so the arm is effective for cat9.
